name: playwright-mobile-lib
description: Cross-platform Playwright mobile fixture (iOS Safari + Android Chrome): connection, capabilities, appium input mode, unsupported-API guards, Zebrunner reporting.

scripts.unit: node --test test/telemetry.test.js test/reporting.test.js test/capabilities.test.js test/device-name.test.js test/use-guard.test.js test/fixture-wiring.test.js test/bundle.test.js test/appium.test.js test/unsupported.test.js test/bridge-proxy-ios.test.js test/bridge-proxy-android.test.js test/ios-driver.test.js test/screenshot-gate.test.js
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run typecheck && node -e "require('./index.js'); console.log('playwright-mobile-lib loads ok')" && npm run unit
